htmlLang.description: Language tag of this catalogue, set as the lang attribute of the popup and the settings page. Not shown.

extensionDescription.message: Save a page region as SVG with real, selectable text and clickable links.
extensionDescription.description: Add-on description in the browser's add-on manager and store.

commandCapture.description: Keyboard shortcut command, listed in the browser's shortcut settings and on the settings page.

commandMenu.description: Keyboard shortcut command that opens the toolbar button's popup, listed in the browser's shortcut settings.

cannotCapture.description: Shown in the popup and as the toolbar button's tooltip. The reason is one of the messages below or an error text of the browser (English or the browser's language).

reason.example: snapii works on HTML pages only

noAccessFirefox.message: Firefox does not let extensions run on this page
noAccessFirefox.description: Reason after "snapii cannot capture this page:" (Firefox build), e.g. on about: pages or addons.mozilla.org.

noAccessChromium.message: The browser does not let extensions run on this page
noAccessChromium.description: Reason after "snapii cannot capture this page:" (Chromium build).

htmlOnly.message: snapii works on HTML pages only
htmlOnly.description: Reason after "snapii cannot capture this page:", e.g. for an SVG or XML document.

noActiveTab.description: Reason after "snapii cannot capture this page:".

noBackgroundAnswer.message: no answer from snapii's background page
noBackgroundAnswer.description: Reason after "snapii cannot capture this page:" when the extension's background did not reply.

popupCapture.description: Main button of the popup: opens the selection overlay on the page.

popupTextFragment.message: Add a link to the selected text
popupTextFragment.description: Popup switch: the saved file links back to the selected passage (a text fragment URL).

popupFolder.message: Save in a folder inside Downloads
popupFolder.description: Popup field label: a sub-folder of the browser's download folder.

popupOcrOffVector.message: Off for the Shapes and text output (see All settings)
popupOcrOffVector.description: Tooltip of the disabled OCR switch. "Shapes and text" is optionsOutputVector, "All settings" is popupAllSettings.

popupAllSettings.description: Popup button that opens the settings page.

couldNotOpenSettings.description: The error is the browser's own text.

notSaved.description: Status when a typed folder or shortcut is refused; the problem is one of the folder or shortcut messages, or the browser's own text.

problem.example: A folder name cannot start or end with a dot.

settingSaveAs.message: Ask where to save each file

settingRemoveTrackers.description: Switch: Copy element link and Copy page link drop tracking parameters from the URL.

folderPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the empty folder field: files go straight into the download folder.

optionsImageFormat.description: Section heading: the format of the picture inside the SVG.

optionsOutput.description: Section heading: what the SVG is made of.

optionsOutputRaster.message: Picture of the page with selectable text

optionsOutputVector.description: Output where boxes and text become SVG shapes instead of a picture.

optionsOutputHint.message: Boxes and text become SVG shapes, so the file stays sharp at any zoom and can be edited. What cannot be drawn as shapes (images, inner shadows, effects) is kept as pixels. Text recognition is off in this mode.

optionsOcclusion.message: Skip text covered by other elements

optionsTextFragment.message: Add a link to the selected text (text fragment)
optionsTextFragment.description: "text fragment" is the web feature behind links to a passage (#:~:text=).

optionsTrackersHint.message: Copy element link and Copy page link leave out tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid and similar).
optionsTrackersHint.description: "Copy element link" and "Copy page link" are the toolbar buttons (toolbarCopyLink, toolbarCopyPageLink).

optionsOcrHint.message: Runs locally; adds a few seconds to saving.

optionsFolder.description: Field label: a sub-folder of the browser's download folder.

optionsFolderHint.message: $RULE$, so this is a sub-folder name such as snapii or Pages/snapii; it is created when needed. Leave it empty for the Downloads folder itself.
optionsFolderHint.description: The rule is insideDownloadsFirefox or insideDownloadsChromium.

rule.example: Firefox lets add-ons save only inside its Downloads folder

insideDownloadsFirefox.message: Firefox lets add-ons save only inside its Downloads folder
insideDownloadsFirefox.description: First half of a sentence (optionsFolderHint, folderAbsolute); Firefox build.

insideDownloadsChromium.message: The browser lets extensions save only inside its Downloads folder
insideDownloadsChromium.description: First half of a sentence (optionsFolderHint, folderAbsolute); Chromium build.

optionsSaved.description: Status on the settings page after a change was stored.

optionsShortcutNone.description: Placeholder of the shortcut field when no key is set.

optionsShortcutSettings.description: Chromium build: button that opens the browser's own shortcut settings page.

optionsShortcutHint.message: Click the field and press the new combination. Escape cancels; Backspace or Delete removes the shortcut.
optionsShortcutHint.description: Escape, Backspace and Delete are keys; use the names your keyboard and browser use.

optionsShortcutHintReadOnly.message: The browser keeps this shortcut. Change it on its shortcut settings page, then reopen this page.

shortcutKeyUnusable.message: This key cannot be used in a shortcut.

problem.example: Use each modifier key only once.

couldNotOpenShortcutSettings.message: Could not open the browser's shortcut settings: $ERROR$
couldNotOpenShortcutSettings.description: The error is the browser's own text.

couldNotReadShortcut.description: The error is the browser's own text.

shortcutModifierRequiredMac.message: Add Command, Option or Control (Shift alone is not enough); only function keys work without a modifier.

shortcutModifierRequiredOther.message: Add Ctrl or Alt (Shift alone is not enough); only function keys work without a modifier.

shortcutDuplicateModifier.message: Use each modifier key only once.

shortcutTooManyModifiers.message: Use at most two modifier keys.

shortcutInvalidKey.message: This key cannot be used. Use a letter, digit, F1-F19, arrow, Home, End, Page Up/Down, Insert, Delete, Space, comma or period.

keyCtrl.description: Key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux), as the browser names the key.

keyShift.description: Key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keySpace.description: Key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keyComma.description: Key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keyPeriod.description: Key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keyHome.description: Key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keyEnd.description: Key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keyPageUp.description: Key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keyPageDown.description: Key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keyInsert.description: Key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keyDelete.description: Key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keyUp.description: Arrow key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keyDown.description: Arrow key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keyLeft.description: Arrow key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

keyRight.description: Arrow key name in a displayed shortcut (Windows, Linux).

folderAbsolute.message: $RULE$, so no full path. Use a name like snapii or Pages/snapii.
folderAbsolute.description: Why a typed folder is refused. The rule is insideDownloadsFirefox or insideDownloadsChromium.

rule.example: Firefox lets add-ons save only inside its Downloads folder

folderParent.message: A folder cannot contain ".." (it would leave the Downloads folder).

folderDot.message: A folder name cannot start or end with a dot.

folderUnsafe.message: A folder name cannot contain : * ? " < > | % , control characters or spaces other than the plain one.

folderReserved.message: This folder name is reserved by the browser (a name such as CON, one that starts or ends with ~, or one that ends in .lnk).

toolbarSave.description: Toolbar button next to the selection on the page. Keep the toolbar buttons short: all five sit in one row.

toolbarCopyText.description: Toolbar button next to the selection.

toolbarCopyLink.description: Toolbar button: copies a link to the selected passage of the page.

toolbarCopyPageLink.description: Toolbar button: copies the page's address.

toolbarCancel.description: Toolbar button: closes the selection overlay.

overlayHint.message: Click an element or drag an area · ↑ ↓ parent/child · Q W E R act on it · Esc cancels
overlayHint.description: Hint at the top of the selection overlay. ↑ ↓ select the enclosing or the inner element; Q W E R are the toolbar keys (letters, not translated); Esc is the key.

noticeViewportOnly.message: Only what is visible can be saved in this browser. Scroll the selection fully into view or select a smaller area
noticeViewportOnly.description: Chromium build: shown when a selection reaches beyond the visible part of the page.

noticeVectorOutside.message: Parts of this selection that are saved as pixels are outside the visible area. Scroll them into view or select a smaller area

toastNoPermission.message: snapii has no permission to capture this page

toastCaptureFailed.message: Capture failed. Try again or select another area

toastTooLarge.message: This area is too large to capture. Select a smaller one

toastDownloadFailed.message: The SVG was not saved (download failed or was cancelled)

toastRecognizing.description: Shown while OCR reads the images of the selection.

toastLateError.message: The selection was captured, but no SVG came of it. Start snapii again to retry

toastSaved.description: After a save. The file name comes from the page title.

toastCopiedLink.description: Copy element link worked: the link points at the selected text.

toastCopiedPageLink.description: A link to the page only (no link to the selected text, or the page link button).

toastLinkAmbiguous.message: Copied page link (no unique text match)
toastLinkAmbiguous.description: Copy element link fell back to the page link: the selected text occurs more than once.

toastLinkTimeout.message: Copied page link (page too large to link the exact text)

toastLinkFailed.message: Copied page link (no text link possible)
